author: Angelique Nelson

materials: Preparing Matrigel dilutions for vessel coating: a. Thaw Matrigel aliquot at 4 °C, for 2 hours - overnight until frozen pellet is no longer visible. b. Dilute thawed Matrigel by adding the appropriate volume of 4 °C, chilled DMEM/F12 media to the 1mL of Matrigel in a 50mL conical tube using a pre-chilled pipette. The volume of DMEM/F12 will be determined by the final protein concentration of the Matrigel. c. Ensure diluted Matrigel is homogenously mixed by carefully, but thoroughly, pipetting the full mixture up and down 3-5 times with the pre-chilled pipette. d. Diluted Matrigel should be used to coat vessels immediately and should not be re-frozen. If spending more than 5 minutes coating vessels from a prepared dilution of Matrigel, keep the dilution at 4 °C, or on ice while working. DMEM⁄F-12 Media - No Phenol Red Gibco - Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #11039-021

AICS cells are grown in a standard 5% CO2 incubator at 37 °C and must be fed fresh mTeSR1 every day. The day of plating is denoted as Day -3 in the differentiation protocol, where Day 0 indicates the start of differentiation. This protocol should take no more than 1-1.5 hours to minimize the time cells are handled. We recommend setting up only 1 line at a time when first using this protocol, gradually increasing the scale of differentiation setup to stay within this time range. Warm Accutase in a water bath at 37 °C . Warm mTeSR1 Room temperature on the bench. steps.title: Prepare mTeSR1 Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh mTeSR1 medium for passaging hiPSCs.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 5X supplement at Room temperature for 4-6 hours, or at 4 °C overnight (do not thaw at 37 °C).
Combine 5X supplement with 400mL mTeSR1 and 5mL Pen/Strep.
Sterile filter the medium using a 0.22µM medium filter before first use.

steps.title: Prepare mTeSR1 with ROCK Inhibitor (Ri)
steps.instruction: Prepare mTeSR1 supplemented with 10µM ROCK inhibitor (Ri) to promote cell survival.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute lyophilized Ri stock in DMSO at 10mM; store as 250µL aliquots at -20 °C for up to 6 months.
Dilute Ri at 1:1000 in mTeSR1 medium (e.g., 100µl Ri into 100mL mTeSR1).
Mix well by pipetting.
Thaw B-27 Supplement (50x) at 4 °C overnight or at Room temperature for 1 hour.
Mix the thawed B-27 Supplement (50x) twice using a 10mL serological pipette.
Combine 10mL B-27 Supplement (50x) with 500mL RPMI Medium 1640 and 5mL Pen/Strep in the RPMI bottle.
Note: Do not sterile filter this medium; do not use medium older than 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare RPMI/B27(-) Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare RPMI Medium 1640 + B-27 Supplement minus insulin.

substeps.instruction: Thaw B-27 Supplement minus insulin at 4 °C overnight or at Room temperature for 1 hour.
Mix the thawed supplement twice using a 10mL serological pipette.
Combine 10mL B-27 Supplement minus insulin with 500mL RPMI Medium 1640 in the RPMI bottle.
Note: Do not sterile filter this medium; do not use medium older than 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare Matrigel Coated Vessels
steps.instruction: Coat vessels with Growth Factor Reduced (GFR) Matrigel at a final protein concentration of 0.337mg/mL.

substeps.instruction: Store Matrigel at -20 °C (short term) or -80 °C (long term); thaw only at 4 °C or on ice.
Aliquot 1mL units from a 10mL vial into 50mL conical tubes using pre-chilled (-20 °C) 5mL serological pipettes, keeping all components on ice.
Store aliquots at -20 °C for up to 3 months.
Add diluted Matrigel to each well/vessel to coat the bottom (refer to Table 1 for volumes).
Wrap coated vessels in Parafilm and store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare Laminin/Fibronectin Coated 96-well Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare specialized coating for differentiation plates.

substeps.instruction: Expose 96-well plates and lids to UV for 10 minutes for sterility.
Plasma treat 96-well glass plates for 1 minute (13.56MHz system, 250mTorr pressure, 100Watts power).
Thaw rhLaminin-521 at 4 °C for 3 hours to overnight.
Prepare a 1:20 dilution of Fibronectin (50µg/mL) in 4 °C chilled DPBS with Ca++ and Mg++ on ice.
Combine diluted rhLaminin-521 and Fibronectin at a 90/10 ratio (e.g., 90µL 20µg/mL rhLaminin to 10µL 5µg/mL Fibronectin).
Add 100µL of the mixture per well using a multichannel pipette.
Wrap in parafilm and store at 4 °C for up to 1 week.
Thaw PDL aliquot at 4 °C overnight or at Room temperature.
Dilute PDL 1:20 by adding 38mL Room temperature DPBS (no Ca++, no Mg++) to 2mL PDL in a 50mL conical tube.
Mix by pipetting up and down 3-5 times with a 25mL pipette.
Add 100µL of PDL/DPBS solution to each well and incubate at Room temperature for 20-60 minutes.
Aspirate PDL/DPBS and wash wells twice with 200µL DPBS per well.
Dry plates in TC biosafety cabinet with lid off for at least 1 hour; store wrapped in parafilm at 4 °C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Passage hiPSCs
steps.instruction: Detach and collect hiPSCs from culture vessels.

substeps.instruction: Verify cells are at 70-85% confluency with <5% cell death.
Add 37 °C pre-warmed Accutase and incubate at 37 °C for 3-5 minutes.
Check for detachment; if necessary, incubate in 2-minute increments until all cells are detached.
Add Room temperature DPBS and gently triturate the suspension 6-10 times (zig-zag motion) using a 5mL serological pipette until homogenous.
Verify >90% single cell suspension via microscope; triturate 4-5 more times if needed.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15mL conical tube.
Rinse vessel once with Room temperature DPBS and add to the conical tube.
Centrifuge cells at 200 x g at Room temperature for 3 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend pellet in mTeSR1 + Ri.

steps.title: Seed Cells for Maintenance or Differentiation
steps.instruction: Plate cells into appropriate vessels based on the intended application.

substeps.instruction: For Maintenance: Seed into new 10cm Matrigel-coated dishes at specific density. Slide vessels front-to-back and side-to-side 2-4 times in the incubator. Incubate at 37 °C, 5% CO2. Change medium to mTeSR1 (no Ri) after 24 hours, then every 24 hours.
For Differentiation (Day -3): Seed into 96-well glass plates at 3-5 different densities (e.g., 8k-14k cells/well).
Prepare troughs with mTeSR1 + Ri and the calculated cell suspension volume.
Aspirate rhLaminin-521/Fibronectin coating from wells using a multichannel aspirator.
Dispense 100µL of cell suspension + medium per well using a P200 multichannel pipette.
Let vessels sit level in the hood for 3-4 minutes before moving to 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator.

steps.title: Differentiation: Days -2 to -1
steps.instruction: Maintain cells in mTeSR1 prior to differentiation.

substeps.instruction: Day -2: Replace medium with 200µL Room temperature mTeSR1 per well.
Day -1: Replace medium with 200µL Room temperature mTeSR1 per well.

Prepare 5µM CHIR99021 in RPMI/B27(-) + Matrigel: Thaw 1mL Matrigel at 4 °C (2h-overnight), make 1:1 dilution with DMEM/F12 (phenol red-free), dilute this 1:30 in RPMI/B27(-), and dilute CHIR99021 (25mM stock) at 1:5000 into this mixture.
Warm the final solution in a 37 °C water bath.
Aspirate old medium and gently add 200µL of 5µM CHIR99021 RPMI/B27(-) to the side of each well.
Incubate at 37 °C, 5% CO2 for 48 hours; record the exact start time.
Prepare 7.5µM IWP 2 in RPMI/B27(-) by diluting IWP 2 (7.5mM stock) 1:1000 in RPMI/B27(-); warm in 37 °C water bath.
Exactly 48 hours (+/- 5 min) after CHIR99021 addition, aspirate old medium.
Gently add 200µL of 7.5µM IWP 2 RPMI/B27(-) to the side of each well.
Incubate at 37 °C, 5% CO2 for 48 hours.
Day 4: Approximately 48 hours (+/- 1h) after IWP 2, replace medium with 200µL pre-warmed RPMI/B27(-). Incubate for 48 hours.
Day 6: Approximately 48 hours (+/- 1h) after Day 4 change, replace medium with 200µL pre-warmed RPMI/B27(+). Incubate for 48 hours.

steps.title: Differentiation: Day 7 to Day 14
steps.instruction: Monitor for beating and maintain cultures.

substeps.instruction: Day 7: Check for beating cells under microscope (10X or 20X magnification); limit time outside incubator to <5 minutes.
Days 8-14: Replace medium with 200µL RPMI/B27(+) every 48 hours.
Check for beating cells every 24-48 hours.
Around Day 12, evaluate cardiac troponin T expression by flow cytometry.
Replace medium twice weekly (e.g., Tuesday and Friday) with 250µL RPMI/B27(+).
Introduce medium at the side of the vessel to avoid dislodging cells.
